description: Pennix v0.7 beta completeness audit fixes
changelog:
**Bug Fixes:**
- Claude statusline preserves the explicit `unbound_ambiguous` state instead of suppressing it as no active task.
- Release preflight recognizes npm's exact-version JSON array response, so already-published beta releases are not planned again.
notes: Run `npm install -g @pennixrv/trellis@beta` then `trellis update`. No `--migrate` required.
